/*selectCommonNoNeUserChoiceMultiPopList*/ SELECT CMPY.COM_CODE , CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC , USR.USER_NAME_LOC , USR.MOBILE_PHONE FROM ICOMLUSR USR, ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE USR.COM_CODE = CMPY.COM_CODE AND USR.STATUS != 'D' AND CMPY.BUSINESS_COND IN ('B','S')
AND USR.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_user_name}||'%'
AND CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
AND ROWNUM < 100 ORDER BY CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC , USR.USER_NAME_LOC

/*selectCommonNoNeUserChoiceMultiSafetyPopList*/ SELECT UR.ALANC_ID AS COM_CODE ,CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM AS COM_NAME_LOC ,UR.USR_NM AS USER_NAME_LOC ,UR.MBLPHON_NO AS MOBILE_PHONE FROM KEPCOUR01@KEPCON UR , KEPMDCP02@KEPCON CP WHERE UR.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND UR.ALANC_ID = CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO AND UR.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'E' AND UR.ALANC_ID != 'KRKORE0001' -- 운영사제외 AND ROWNUM < 100
AND UR.USR_NM LIKE '%'||#{st_user_name}||'%'
AND CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
UNION ALL
SELECT UR.ALANC_ID AS COM_CODE ,(SELECT CP01.ALANC_NM FROM KEPMDCP01@KEPCON CP01 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP.ALANC_ID) AS COM_NAME_LOC ,UR.USR_NM AS USER_NAME_LOC ,UR.MBLPHON_NO AS MOBILE_PHONE FROM KEPCOUR01@KEPCON UR , KEPMDCP04@KEPCON CP WHERE UR.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND UR.ALANC_ID = CP.SPPLR_ID AND UR.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'E' AND UR.ALANC_ID != 'KRKORE0001' -- 운영사제외
AND UR.USR_NM LIKE '%'||#{st_user_name}||'%'
AND (SELECT CP01.ALANC_NM FROM KEPMDCP01@KEPCON CP01 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP.ALANC_ID) LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
AND ROWNUM < 100 ORDER BY 2,3

/*selectCommonNoNeUserChoiceMultiKwayPopList*/ SELECT UR.customer_code AS COM_CODE ,CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM AS COM_NAME_LOC ,UR.NAME_KOR AS USER_NAME_LOC ,UR.MOBILE AS MOBILE_PHONE FROM stream.mst_user@KEPCON UR , KEPMDCP03@KEPCON CP WHERE UR.record_status != 'D' AND UR.approve_status = '048002' AND UR.customer_code != '1418' -- 운영사제외 AND UR.customer_code = CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO AND ROWNUM < 100
AND UR.NAME_KOR LIKE '%'||#{st_user_name}||'%'
AND CP.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
UNION ALL SELECT UR.supplier_code AS COM_CODE ,CP.SUPPLIER_KOR AS COM_NAME_LOC ,UR.NAME_KOR AS USER_NAME_LOC ,UR.MOBILE AS MOBILE_PHONE FROM stream.mst_user@KEPCON UR , KEPMDCP05@KEPCON CP WHERE UR.record_status != 'D' AND UR.approve_status = '048002' AND UR.supplier_code = CP.SPPLR_ID
AND UR.NAME_KOR LIKE '%'||#{st_user_name}||'%'
AND CP.SUPPLIER_KOR LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
AND ROWNUM < 100 ORDER BY 2,3
